## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Messina, Italy. It starts at Viale della Libertà, 465.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Acquaint your arty side with the riches of Sicily at the Interdisciplinary Regional Museum of Messina, and journey through the evolution of Sicilian art as you peruse centuries worth of paintings, sculptures, and priceless jewels.
>
> From the Middle Ages through the Renaissance and Baroque eras, and culminating in the 17th, 18th, and 19th centuries, a chronological array of themed exhibitions tells the story of Sicily in a spectacular display of masterpieces and precious treasures.

## Where this page comes from
